race.description: Toka Love Ya Dnt Showcase Hcp (C1)
race.comment: TEELG (2) got off the mark first-up on a heavy surface and has struggled in his two subsequent runs in town from wide barriers. Gets the brow band added today from the right draw. Will prove hard to stop in this contest. SUPER LUCK DRAGON (1) resumed for the new yard with a solid Maiden win over 1000m at Eagle Farm. Will keep improving as he jumps in trip now the penny has dropped. SIR DON (5) appreciated the good draw second up when he broke his Maiden tag with a fighting win over 1200m at the Gold Coast. Gets a similar set-up here and can keep the winning momentum going. TILL DUSK (3) is resuming with a host of gear changes and now in the Chris & Corey Munce yard. Has a good fresh record and ran fourth in a recent 1000m trial at Doomben. Worth thought.
